description: Creates a client intake link (fee agreement with fees prefilled, then retainer) and texts it from the firm's intake number. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

mobile.description: Client US mobile; the link is texted here.

name.description: Client full name as it goes on the agreement.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

monthly_payment.description: Monthly plan amount, only with a payment plan. The first payment is one month after the retainer is paid, set automatically.

pretrial_fee.description: Pretrial Legal-Services Fee. Optional: leave out (or 0) when there is none; the agreement then reads "None".

retainer.description: True Availability Retainer; the client pays this through the link.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

charges.description: Several charges, e.g. ["DWI 1st", "Possession of Marijuana"]; joined "; " on the agreement and in Clio.

offense.description: Offense or charges as one line, e.g. "DWI 1st". Alternative to charges.

name.description: Who pays, only if not the client.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

send.description: sms (default) texts the link now from the firm's intake number; none returns it to you.

name: create_intake_link
title: Create intake link
